title: Case-insensitive author filter (COLLATE NOCASE) is never exercised
evidence: store.go:71 uses `WHERE author = ? COLLATE NOCASE`, but api_test.go:129 filters with exact-case `?author=Jane+Austen`; no test asserts a differing-case match returns rows
suggestion: Add a case-varied author query assertion so the NOCASE behavior is covered

title: Input validation exceeds the spec
evidence: handlers.go:64 rejects trailing JSON tokens, handlers.go:60 caps body at 1 MiB (maxBodyBytes), handlers.go:85 enforces year 0-9999
suggestion: None — beyond the required title/author checks; noted for cross-run comparison
